description:
The thinking-level indicator was added to the footer right side, but two parity gaps remain.

**IMPLEMENTED (Elixir `Footer.model_part/1`):**
```elixir
case f.thinking_level do
  nil   -> f.model_id
  level -> "#{f.model_id} · #{level}"
end
```
Uses `·` (U+00B7 MIDDLE DOT). When level is `:off`, emits `"off"`.

**EXPECTED (Node.js `Footer.render`):**
```typescript
const thinkingLevel = state.thinkingLevel || "off";
rightSideWithoutProvider =
  thinkingLevel === "off"
    ? `${modelName} • thinking off`
    : `${modelName} • ${thinkingLevel}`;
```

Key details — both the separator and the label are variable:
- Separator is `•` (U+2022 BULLET) — not `·` (U+00B7 MIDDLE DOT)
- One space on each side of the bullet: `modelName + " • " + level`
- When `thinkingLevel === "off"`, the label is `"thinking off"` (two words), not just `"off"`
- When level is `"low"`, `"medium"`, or `"high"`, the label is the level string verbatim
- The whole right side is styled `theme.fg("dim", ...)` — dim (same as the rest of the stats line)

**Gaps:**
1. Wrong separator: `·` (U+00B7) should be `•` (U+2022)
2. Wrong label for the off state: `"off"` should be `"thinking off"`

**Where to fix:**
- `apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/components/footer.ex` `model_part/1`: change `·` to `•`
- `apps/octo_pi_tui/lib/octo_pi/tui/interactive.ex` `thinking_level_label/1`: return `"thinking off"` for `:off`

**Verification:**
Start `bin/pi -m openrouter/minimax/minimax-m2.7` in `tmux pi-comparison`. Footer bottom-right should show `minimax/minimax-m2.7 • thinking off` (not `minimax/minimax-m2.7 · off`).
title: TUI-3: Missing model quality/speed indicator ('medium') in status bar
